title: Interface B v1: forecast feed (backend to agent)
description: Today's hourly distraction risk, for the agent to cache so that nudges keep working with no internet. Spec: FR-20 (hourly risk for today, trains after 14 days), FR-21 (nudge about 5 minutes before a predicted high-risk window, with a suggested focus block), FR-15 (best focus hours, weekday/weekend separated), risks table ('smart defaults', show confidence, start forecast at day 14). The agent decides when and whether to nudge; this feed carries no nudge limits (2/day, cooldown after 2 ignores are agent-side).

feed_version.description: Increases with every new feed for this device. Used as the ETag so the agent can ask 'anything newer?' cheaply.

valid_until.description: The agent may nudge from this cached feed until this moment, offline or not. What happens after expiry (no nudges?) and who chooses the lifetime is OQ-B3.

status.description: ready: a forecast is included. insufficient_data: fewer than 14 days of data, no forecast yet (the spec waits for at least 14 days).

source.description: personal_model: the per-user model (FR-20). smart_defaults: aggregated patterns shipped while data is thin (risks table). Whether smart defaults reach the agent through this feed is OQ-B1.

timezone.description: IANA zone name (for example Asia/Karachi), so the local day and DST are unambiguous.

forecast_date.description: The local calendar date the hours belong to. Horizon is today only in this version (OQ-B4).

hours.description: Risk for each hour of forecast_date. Up to 25 entries to allow a DST day.

confidence.description: How sure the model is about this hour, 0 to 1 (spec: show confidence).

high_risk.description: True if this hour is flagged as a high-risk window (the hours whose precision FR-20 measures). Who owns the flag threshold is OQ-B6.

focus_windows.description: Detected best focus hours (FR-15), weekday and weekend separately, as local minutes of the day. The agent needs a suggested focus block for each nudge (FR-21); the spec does not say who proposes it: OQ-B2. Optional.
